items.name: ErrorContext
items.summary: General context for an error. For many errors, the root cause is some steps removed from what the user sees. For example:   class C:     def __lt__(self, other: C) -> bool:   C() < 0  # ERROR: expected C, got 0 The root cause is `C.__lt__`…

items.name: TypeCheckContext
